description: Refresh the saved Play Console session in place, with no new browser sign-in. Google rotates the __Secure-1PSIDTS/__Secure-3PSIDTS session cookies about every 10 minutes; the captured copy goes stale and every tool then returns 401 UNAUTHENTICATED — or list_accounts returns an empty list — even though the user never signed out. Every tool already retries this automatically on a 401, so call it deliberately before a long sequence, or to tell a stale cookie apart from a session that has genuinely ended (if this succeeds and no account is signed in, only start_browser_auth will help).

notification_message.description: Short user-facing sentence for this action if the follow-up reply fails. Plain text only; do not mention template syntax or variable names.

name: refresh_browser_session
